_readme: Fixed settings for the Part Wise Connectivity report. Month-specific inputs live in config/months/YYYY-MM.json.
_supabase_note: Calling Analytics (the calling dashboard). Calls and stage changes are kept 90 days there; older months come from history/.
_report_note: Drive folder 'Team performance & Reports > Partwise Data'. One Google Sheet per month, created on the first run and overwritten in place after that (same link).
_uzair_note: Live sheet 'Followup / Discovery / Roadmap Created LSQ Live Sheet of Team Uzair'. It is reset each month and the old one is renamed '... LSQ - Team Uzair (<Month>)' in the same folder; past months are read from that copy.
_lookback_note: Prior months whose Discovery/Roadmap stages feed the two Stage -> Enrollments columns (Amit, 4 Oct 2026).
